title: PhysKerr + small complex MLP on the residual
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit)
model: y = PhysKerr(z) + MLP_res(z) (phys_models.PhysPlusMLP); MLP_res = one hidden complex layer with Kerr activation (AblationComplexMLP d), output layer initialized to zero so the hybrid starts equal to PhysKerr; complex MSE loss
phys_choice: configuration (R, L, sym) and lr branch with the best mean validation reduction in experiments/E016_phys_kerr_only/results/phys_kerr.csv, written to results/e016_choice.json when the stage is built; run ids contain R, L, sym
modes_note: frozen: PhysKerr trained steps_per_stage steps (MLP_res frozen at zero), then frozen while MLP_res is trained steps_per_stage steps with a fresh optimizer; joint: both from scratch, 2 x steps_per_stage steps (equal budget)
lr_policy: the lr branch under which the chosen PhysKerr configuration was best in E016 (const_1e-3, best_e010_cm1 or best_e010_cm30); if E016 results are missing: best_e010 = experiments/E010_lr_schedule_study/results/stage3_choice.json['a'] as is (c_mult 30); if that is missing too: const_1e-3. Deviation from the original plan (always best_e010): the E016 smoke showed c_mult 30 collapsing some PhysKerr runs, so the validation-chosen branch is used when it exists
macs: PhysKerr macs_phys + MLP_res h(4W + 11) = h*135 (one hidden layer, nothing to merge)

metrics.seed_spread: range; the larger of the two compared groups

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.better_at_equal_cost: the hybrid (any h, any mode) with multiplies <= 6480 and the best mean validation reduction beats on test both complex_a (this experiment, 5 seeds) and the E016 configuration chosen by validation (5 seeds) by >= 1 p.p. and by more than the seed spread
rule_draft.residual_net_not_needed: for h = 4, both frozen and joint differ on test from the chosen E016 configuration by less than the seed spread
rule_draft.frozen_vs_joint: reported as an observation only, no verdict
